title: The Concept of Quantum Entanglement
text:
Quantum entanglement describes a physical phenomenon where two or more particles become linked in such a way that they share the same existence, regardless of the distance separating them. Measuring a property (such as spin) of one particle instantaneously influences the corresponding properties of all other entangled particles, a correlation Einstein famously termed "spooky action at a distance."

The mathematical implications of this link suggest that the entangled system must be treated as a single unit, rather than individual components. This counter-intuitive aspect challenges classical notions of locality and realism, forming the bedrock for advanced quantum computing and secure communication protocols.
